cross_page_current_book.detail: The completed query-state view visibly claims that current-book context changed, but its top banner still says 草稿态 · 未入库. Navigation to /new-book/workbench.html was blocked by the in-app browser with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT. Chrome control was unavailable in this environment, so no real-browser cross-page confirmation was possible.

layout_and_interaction.prototype_continuity: PARTIAL: sidebar, top bar, five-stage strip, central assistant pane, and right timeline are visibly retained.
layout_and_interaction.normal_1440x900: P1 visual defects observed: sidebar brand overlaps; rating stars overflow horizontally.

layout_and_interaction.disabled_controls: Workspace uses pointer-events:none while controls retain enabled semantics (the tested AI button reported enabled); review keyboard/accessibility disablement during rework.
layout_and_interaction.fabricated_data: Runtime normal-state disclosure labels prototype content as editable initial values rather than facts. No P1 finding recorded on this point.

findings.title: Completed state contradicts the persisted-status banner
findings.detail: The runtime status says 新书已创建 and current-book context switched, but the persistent top pill still says 草稿态 · 未入库. This gives mutually exclusive creation outcomes and prevents acceptance of FP001-06 context transition evidence.

findings.title: Responsive stage navigation is clipped at 1280x720
findings.detail: The fifth phase is visibly cut off at the right edge, so the five-stage workflow is not fully reachable/readable at the required desktop viewport.

findings.title: Sidebar branding and rating content overlap/overflow
findings.detail: The sidebar logo text overlays the deployed_code label. At 1440x900 the rating stars run across the right summary panel instead of fitting their container.

findings.title: Disabled workspace leaves tested button semantically enabled
findings.detail: In loading state, 补全核心卖点 has enabled semantics even though CSS blocks pointer events. Use native disabled or equivalent keyboard-safe handling.

findings.title: Cross-page current_book context lacks obtainable browser evidence
findings.detail: The auditor could not navigate from the page to its workbench target in the available in-app browser, and Chrome control was unavailable. Re-audit after providing a browser surface that can load both local routes.
